verified_observations.observation: Verified one institutional Open Access manifestation for Evans & Osada (2005), handle 1885/54663, with repository-listed PDF 01_Evans_Mundari:_The_myth_of_a_2005.pdf (234.31 KB). Direct repository fetch returned HTTP 403, so PDF bytes/page locators were not claimed.

Publisher verifies DOI 10.1515/lity.2005.9.3.351, Linguistic Typology 9(3), pages 351-390, online date 2005-12-21 and print date 2005-12-12; abstract supports bounded article-scope and methodological provenance statements.
Independent institutional bibliographic record corroborates authors, journal, volume/issue, 40-page extent, DOI and December 2005 publication.
Rechecked a 2023 Mundari-speakers map with CC BY-SA 4.0 file licence; it remains a derivative/user-created map and is not promoted as an official Census geographic claim.
